verdict.rationale: The only fee information on the agency's own pages is that a certificate of good standing can be printed or validated 'at no cost'. No dollar amounts appear in the evidence for formation, annual reports, amendments, registered agent changes or expedite. Those pages are referenced, but their fees are not shown. missing for 10: published amounts for LLC/corporation formation filings, annual report fee schedule, amendment/reinstatement/expedite fees, a consolidated fee schedule page, independent corroboration.
